prompt: What is your opinion on the role of robotics in the future of work?

modelPlan.focus: Explore the transformative role of robotics in the future of work, balancing the potential for job displacement with the opportunities for human-machine collaboration.
keyArguments: Robotics will automate routine tasks, leading to job displacement in certain sectors, particularly in manual and low-skilled labor.
However, robotics will also create new job opportunities and necessitate upskilling and reskilling of the workforce to adapt to the changing labor force dynamics.
